nom: Urban Veda Radiance Brightening Face Scrub

avis.texte: I followed the directions and used it a couple times a week and my face is soooo soft and bright. It takes off all the dead skin cells really well. I have sensitive skin and was nervous about the smell. But no breakouts or irritation. I wish I knew about this product tear as ago. I think I'm going to try to use this daily like some of the reviews have mentioned.

I've had this product for two months now. I would not recommend for sensitive, acne-prone skin. I continue to attempt to use it, but it gives me a raised rash reaction all over my face, especially my forehead and chin.
Its good for a cheap exfoliator. Definitely gets the job done. I use this once a week in my cleansing routine and it keeps my skin nicely polished.

avis.titre: Great value for a strong product
avis.texte: Leaves my face feeling fresh in the morning - not sure what I'd do without it!

avis.titre: Good value for money facial scrub
avis.texte: This facial scrub is a good price and doesn't contain anything harsh for sensitive skins. Fine grains don't scratch the skin and it leaves skin smooth and soft. Recommended
This exfoliator is very gentle, great for daily use. Would buy again
really good scrubby exfoliator. i use every night. fragrance is light, not too overpowering, guess from other reviews people just don't prefer the scent but personally like it

I received a sample tube of this and used it weekly for a while. My face doesn't feel clean clean unless I use this in the shower. The tiny beads do not melt and I can exfoliate and massage my skin as long as I want. The smell is amazing and floral and I haven't found that in any other product. I love it so much and my face glows and makeup looks so much better after exfoliating.

After using it for a while it began giving me eczema. I think it's because I forgot I had used a chemical exfoliating product too close to using this. Just a turn off though. It does smell nice to me though. Oh also it is really hard to get all the little beads off. A wash cloth wet didn't work. I had to splash water on my face several times and that gets annoying when I just want to polish my face real quick

avis.titre: Love the texture, hate the scent!
avis.texte: Must be my pregnancy hormones but I just did not like the smell. I loved the light grit texture, perfect for my dry/sensitive skin. If the smell was better I'd say it'd be a part of my weekly routine! I did end up returning it ):

There is nothing Ayurvedic about putting fragrance in something. A perfect example of a company that's inappropriately taken an ancient practice and mass marketed it without any thought of what is actually in it. So disappointing.

I got a small container of this and used it all up. I like it! Gentle exfoliating. Smells soooo good. I found I liked it as a daily cleaner. The label didn't make it clear how to use it so I didn't know what it was. I'm thinking of buying it again and trying out more of their products. I miss it.

Compared to other facial exfoliants this opens up my pores to a healthy level, and feels incredibly gentle on my skin. There is no irritation or redness after it, and using the night cream or facial oil after this just makes my skin feel so soft, and renewed :) I definitely recommend it.

Excellent product, but not surprised! Notable is the lightness here, it's almost weightless but when it's applied it's heavy with ingredients that do enrich the skin you'll notice a difference. A clearness of complexion and a brightness leaving softer skin. It dries very quickly on the skin when applied, and has a lovely mellow scent so leave it on and let it do its job. Worth every penny...
I have been using this for a few weeks now, I have noticed a massive change in my skin and that now it has a glow to it, definitely recommend.

The scrub is really tiny but thorough. Which is a big pro for me. It does what it needs to do and gives your skin that beautiful clean and fresh feeling. Even considering to buy the rest of this product line. I just can't get over the smell!
Only a tiny amount is required to wash the face, and the fragrance is beautiful, the texture is just right, not too soft not too scratchy. Enjoying it.
Beautiful formula, really gentle on the skin with the cream based exfoliator and the tiny exfoliating particles. Feels very luxurious.
This is the best exfoliator I've found yet, it's gentle on the skin but gets the dead skin cells out no bother. Would definitely buy another after it runs out.

avis.titre: My skin is so soft after using this
avis.texte: Having tried Urban Veda before I was keen to try another skin exfoliator & bought this. So glad I did. It works well leaving my skin feeling very clean & soft plus it's smells gorgeous. Going to be a regular product in my shopping basket!
Really wonderful, helped clear dark spots on my face, love every product from the radiance line.

avis.titre: Skin feels smooth and looks clear
avis.texte: This scrub is so good! I noticed the difference after one application, my skin felt so smooth and radiant! I really like the texture of the polish as it doesn't feel as harsh as other exfoliating products I've used in the past and can easily be incorporated into your daily skin care routine. Like all of Urban Veda's products it smells amazing too!
Lovely packaging, easy to use, gentle exfoliation, pleasant smell... Good for daily use... Skin felt nice afterwards.

I received a small sample of the Urban Veda turmeric face scrub & was amazed at the difference in my skin texture after the first application. I have sensitive, acne prone skin & wanted something for my skin that would help with old scarring & also help soothe my skin at the same time. AMAZING!!! It's been 3 weeks & I exfoliate every four days and the appearance of my skin is smoother & softer. Most of my scars are lighter in colour & depth. One happy lady x

This face scrub range is excellent - they are hard to find as most are face washes and I prefer a scrub - I have been using it for some years and would not change so I hope they continue with the product.
Beautiful formula, really gentle on the skin with the cream based exfoliator and the tiny exfoliating particles. Feels very luxurious.

avis.titre: urban veda radiance exfoliation facial polish
avis.texte: This is the best exfoliator I've found yet, it's gentle on the skin but gets the dead skin cells out no bother. Would definitely buy another after it runs out.

avis.titre: My skin is so soft after using this
avis.texte: Having tried Urban Veda before I was keen to try another skin exfoliator & bought this. So glad I did. It works well leaving my skin feeling very clean & soft plus it's smells gorgeous. Going to be a regular product in my shopping basket!
Lovely packaging, easy to use, gentle exfoliation, pleasant smell... Good for daily use... Skin felt nice afterwards.

This face scrub range is excellent - they are hard to find as most are face washes and I prefer a scrub - I have been using it for some years and would not change so I hope they continue with the product.
Makes my skin glow! Doesn't irritate my acne prone skin, makes my pores look smaller! Smells great, easy to wash off! Overall win win win!!!!
